'''Julià Fernàndez Ariza''' (born 19 November 1974)<ref>[https://int.soccerway.com/players/julia-fernandez/39831/ Soccerway profile]</ref> is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|footballer]]. He currently plays for [[FC Santa Coloma|Santa Coloma]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]]. He has won both the [[Andorran First Division]] and the [[Andorran Cup]] several times.

==Club career==
Fernàndez scored the only goal in the [[UEFA Cup 2007–08|UEFA Cup 2007–08 first qualifying round]] against [[Maccabi Tel Aviv F.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]], the first goal ever in a win for a team from Andorra in a European Cup. However, [[Maccabi Tel Aviv F.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]] went on to win 4–0.{{citation needed|date=June 2012}}

==International career==
He also scored a consolation goal for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in the squad's [[2008 UEFA European Football Championship qualifying Group E|2008 UEFA European Football Championship qualifying]] match against [[Israel national football team|Israel]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://en.archive.uefa.com/competitions/euro2012/history/season=2008/round=2241/match=83920/index.html |title=Welcome to nginx! |website=[[UEFA]] |access-date=2 February 2022 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130105040052/http://en.archive.uefa.com/competitions/euro2012/history/season=2008/round=2241/match=83920/index.html |archive-date=5 January 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref>
